name: web-liquid-glass-quote-card-dark-grid
title: Liquid-glass quote card on a dark tech grid
whatItIs: A jagged-edged glass panel with a refractive, watery texture floats over a black grid background, holding a quote with glass orb decorations at its corners.
whatItMeans: The distorted refraction and dark grid evoke a futuristic, tactile surface, giving a plain text quote the weight of a physical object.
techniques: render translucent panels with visible refraction/distortion instead of flat blur
notch the panel edges irregularly to break the usual glass-rectangle cliché
anchor the card with small glass sphere props to reinforce the material

vocabulary.definition: a UI style simulating frosted or refractive glass via blur, transparency and light edges
